label: Local link (Analytics)
type: the default analytics:analytics-link type, connecting an Analytics scope to the local Couchbase Server cluster's own Data service. Uniquely uneditable and undeletable among the three link kinds (local/remote/external) - a page states this as a stated asymmetry, not an oversight.
evidence: In Analytics, a link represents a connection to a data source. The default type of link is a Local link.
you must connect the link, so that collections on the link can shadow data from their data sources.
You can edit a remote link or an external link. You cannot edit a local link.
relates_to_competency_question: Which Analytics link type connects to the same cluster's own Data service, and can it be edited or deleted like the other link types?
